## Summary
Encodes and decodes the AV1 RTP dependency descriptor header extension. The package owns descriptor data models, bitstream readers and writers, dependency-structure parsing, template selection, and payload size calculation.

## Responsibilities
- Represent dependency descriptors, frame dependency structures, templates, decode target indications, and render resolutions.
- Read descriptor payloads from bit-packed RTP header extension bytes.
- Write descriptor payloads using mandatory fields, extended fields, template structures, and frame-specific overrides.
- Provide bit-level read and write helpers for fixed-width and non-symmetric integer encodings.
